argument_macro_structure.dominant_argument_form: Dialectical progression from problem to resolution, with repeated qualifications and distinctions.
argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: Moderate: many premises are implicit but recoverable from context.

argumentative_quality.dialectical_reasonableness: High: engages with counterarguments and qualifies claims.
argumentative_quality.logical_relevance: High: all sections contribute to the central question of genealogy's evaluative role.
argumentative_quality.premise_acceptability: Moderate: some premises (e.g., life-enhancement as standard) are contestable but defended.

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: Acknowledges objections (e.g., genetic fallacy, abuse of will to power) and responds by refining the standard.

method_and_evidence.evidence_type: Conceptual analysis, historical narrative, psychological explanation, typological distinctions.

philosophical_orientation.grounding: Naturalistic and perfectionist, but interpretive rather than reductive.
philosophical_orientation.sentiment: Critical of universalism, formal ethics, and moral monism; affirmative of pluralism and rank.
philosophical_orientation.thematic_focus: Genealogy, morality, will to power, life-enhancement, immanent critique.

structural_organization.structure_type: Sectioned essay with clear headings and progressive argumentation.

summary_of_core_decisions: The text defends Nietzsche's genealogy as a form of immanent critique that avoids the genetic fallacy by focusing on the present relation between values and life, using life-enhancement as a comparative standard.

thesis_commitment.hedging_density_in_final_paragraph: Moderate: acknowledges limits and risks while affirming the core argument.
